notes: One of the largest Episcopal parishes in Arizona (about 400 households; reported average Sunday attendance around 404 in 2024), in the Catalina Foothills, and an architectural landmark. IN TRANSITION: the parish is in a rector search as of 2026 - Richard Mallory is interim rector and a parish profile was posted in April 2026. Expect the 2025-2026 pulpit to be shared among interim and supply clergy, so attribute sermons individually. Episcopal preaching follows the Revised Common Lectionary, which raises the baseline overlap with published lectionary commentaries; account for that in any similarity review. No sermon video host was confirmed - check stphilipstucson.org.
